description: Resolve a Node.js dependency version conflict. The terminal shows an error from 'npm install' indicating that react-dom@18.2.0 requires react@^18.0.0 (version 18.x), but the project currently has react@17.0.2 installed. You need to: (1) Open package.json using Ctrl+P, (2) Find the 'react' dependency entry in the 'dependencies' section, (3) Update the version from '^17.0.2' to '^18.0.0' or '^18.2.0', (4) Save the file with Ctrl+S. The conflict will be resolved when react is updated to version 18.x which is compatible with react-dom@18.2.0.
